extDescription.message: Copies the right-clicked image (img / CSS background / canvas / SVG) to the clipboard as PNG and keeps the most recent ones cached.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in chrome://extensions and the store.

actionTitle.description: Tooltip of the toolbar button, and the popup heading.

toastCopying.description: Toast shown while the image is being fetched and converted.

toastCopied.description: Toast shown after a successful copy.

toastCopyFailed.description: Toast shown when copying failed. $1 is the error message.

errorImageNotFound.description: The right-clicked element did not contain an image.

errorFetchFailed.description: Fallback error when the background fetch returns no reason.

errorNotImage.description: The fetched resource was not an image. $1 is its MIME type.

errorSvgRender.description: The SVG could not be drawn into a canvas.

errorImageLoad.description: The image could not be loaded for the legacy copy path.

errorClipboardDenied.message: Writing to the clipboard was denied
errorClipboardDenied.description: The browser rejected the clipboard write.

popupLimitPrefix.description: Text before the number-of-items dropdown, as in "Keep [20] items".

popupLimitSuffix.description: Text after the number-of-items dropdown, as in "Keep [20] items".

popupEmpty.message: Right-click an image on a page and choose “Copy image to clipboard” to collect it here.
popupEmpty.description: Shown when the cache is empty.

popupRemoveOne.description: Tooltip of the × button on a thumbnail.

popupTileCopied.description: Overlay label on a thumbnail right after it is copied. Keep it short.

popupStatusCopied.description: Status line after a successful re-copy.

popupStatusCleared.description: Status line after the cache is emptied.

popupStatusFailed.description: Status line after a failed re-copy. $1 is the error message.
